llm.label: LLM
llm.description: Call an AI model once, optionally providing tool definitions and receiving tool calls

intent.label: Intent classification
intent.description: Match user questions to predefined intent categories

speechToText.label: Speech to text
speechToText.description: Convert audio to text using a speech recognition model

textToSpeech.label: Text to speech
textToSpeech.description: Convert text to audio using a speech synthesis model

imageGenerate.label: Image generation
imageGenerate.description: Generate images from the provided text

imageToVideo.label: Image to video
imageToVideo.description: Generate videos from the provided images

textToVideo.label: Text to video
textToVideo.description: Generate videos from the provided text

imageUnderstand.label: Image understanding
imageUnderstand.description: Identify objects and scenes in images to answer user questions

videoUnderstand.label: Video understanding
videoUnderstand.description: Identify objects and scenes in videos to answer user questions

questionOptimization.label: Question optimization
questionOptimization.description: Refine the current question using conversation history to better match knowledge segments

reply.label: Specified reply
reply.description: Return the specified content, converting referenced variables to strings

condition.label: Condition
condition.description: Run different nodes based on conditions

form.label: Form collection
form.description: Collect user information during a conversation and use the form data in subsequent steps

variableAssign.label: Variable assignment
variableAssign.description: Update the values of global variables

variableAggregation.label: Variable aggregation
variableAggregation.description: Aggregate each group of variables using the configured strategy

variableSplitting.label: Variable splitting
variableSplitting.description: Parse and split JSON variables using JSON Path expressions

parameterExtraction.label: Parameter extraction
parameterExtraction.description: Extract structured parameters using an AI model

searchKnowledge.label: Knowledge retrieval
searchKnowledge.description: Relate knowledge and find segments relevant to the question
searchKnowledge.directAnswerContent: Segment content eligible for direct answers

searchDocument.label: Document tag retrieval
searchDocument.description: Find documents matching the specified tags within the configured search scope

documentExtract.label: Document content extraction
documentExtract.description: Parse input documents and output structured content

reranker.label: Multi-source retrieval
reranker.description: Rerank retrieval results from multiple knowledge sources using a reranking model

mcp.label: MCP call
mcp.description: Run tools on MCP servers over SSE or Streamable HTTP

customTool.label: Custom tool
customTool.description: Process data by running custom scripts

loop.label: Loop
loop.description: Repeat a series of tasks using the configured iteration count and logic

loopContinue.label: Continue
loopContinue.description: End the current iteration and continue with the next one

loopBreak.label: Break
loopBreak.description: Stop the loop and exit its body

documentSplit.label: Document segmentation
documentSplit.description: Split input document content into a list of segments using the segmentation strategy

localFile.label: Local files
localFile.description: Upload local documents and output a document list. Use the Document content extraction node to parse their contents

webSource.label: Web site
webSource.description: Crawl web data from a root URL and output documents with content, with one document per URL

knowledgeWrite.label: Write to knowledge
knowledgeWrite.description: Write the input segments to the current knowledge and generate embeddings
